root.name: Queen's Indian Defense: Yates Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. Nf3 Bb4+ 4. Bd2 a5 5. g3 b6 6. Bg2 Bb7

overview: This is a Bogo-Indian move order with 3...Bb4+ 4.Bd2 a5, followed by ...b6 and ...Bb7, reaching a Queen's Indian set-up with White's fianchetto. White castles and develops with Nc3, while Black prepares ...Bxd2 or ...O-O. Play is positional and slow.

white_ideas.idea: Use the bishop pair if Black gives up the dark bishop

black_ideas.idea: Fianchetto on b7 and hold e4 with ...d6 or ...d5
Trade the dark bishop or retreat to e7

typical_structures.structure: Queen's Indian with pawns on c4/d4 against ...e6/...b6

character.notes: Quiet manoeuvring with few forcing lines.

character.reason: Black's position is hard to break and play is steady.

approach.reason: It is a normal Indian line.
